title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 15] Complete auth negative states, deep-link recovery and session lifecycle
declared_commit: fix(auth): harden consumer session and deep-link lifecycle

red.scenario: The exact session lifecycle acceptance command and return-to browser spec fail before the contract and implementation exist.
invocations: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-lifecycle.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep return-to
red.observable: Both commands exit 1: npm reports a missing script and Playwright reports the missing session lifecycle spec.

green.observable: The machine-checkable session contract and 3 Vitest files pass with 55 tests; the negative fixture rejects 5 unsafe return targets.

criteria.scenario: Expired and invalid sessions issue one localized login redirect and preserve only an allowlisted return target.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-lifecycle.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep return-to
criteria.observable: 1 passed; login succeeds through the fixture auth provider and reloads the encoded deep link with its query string.

criteria.scenario: Foreign and deleted books share a safe owner-scoped not-found surface without private titles or browser data requests.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-lifecycle.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep "expired|foreign|deleted"
criteria.observable: 3 passed; expired/invalid redirect once, foreign and deleted IDs render the same not-found state, and private markers are absent.

criteria.scenario: Logout from a deep link clears the browser session and an auth bootstrap network failure renders a safe unavailable boundary.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-lifecycle.spec.ts --project=chromium
criteria.observable: 6 passed; logout calls the auth provider, the deep link is gated again, and bootstrap loss has no consumer shell or private data.

surface.observable: Fresh Chromium captures show readable dark not-found state and a localized unavailable bootstrap state; the dark state tokens were verified after the first contrast review.
surface.contrastFollowUp: Book and reading route BLab states inherit data-blab-theme=dark so state text remains readable on the consumer dark surface.

review.tool: git diff review, TypeScript, ESLint and focused Vitest review
notes: Auth return targets are normalized once through getConsumerSignInRedirectPath and getSafeNextPath.
Proxy failures fail closed and server book reads stay owner scoped with deleted_at excluded.
Error boundaries render generic localized copy without interpolating provider errors or book titles.
Native-only capabilities and the protected BLDS worktree remain unchanged.

verification.observable: The clean feature commit passes the full Vitest/parity/BLDS/UI contract suite, TypeScript, ESLint and Next production build; parity negative fixtures pass 59/59.

cleanup.observable: The protected BLDS worktree and unrelated dirty worktree were preserved; task-local Playwright and Next processes terminate after each run.
